Hi Mira,

You’re right that simply renaming both reports to “notes” could actually make it harder to distinguish between the two inspections later on. A safer approach is to keep their distinct names (e.g., `Inspection_2023_Q1` and `Inspection_2023_Q2`) but open each file individually first to verify the contents before proceeding with any merging or mixing of data.

Regarding where our work should happen, I’m currently operating locally on this dashboard—no files have been renamed or altered yet. Let me know if you’d like more details on either point!
